summary: Baird Medical Investment Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a US$4,347,826 senior 8% original issue discount convertible promissory note plus up to 110,070 ordinary shares as payout shares, dated September 24, 2026. The note carries an 8% OID, 12-month term, no current interest (15% default rate), ranks senior to all existing debt and equity, and converts at the lower of a $0.9842 fixed price or 92% of the seven-day lowest VWAP, with a Nasdaq-minimum-based floor. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
